official_definition: On Stage (Your Attack Step) Instead of attacking with this Spirit, by returning this Spirit to the deckbottom, summon one "Stage Style" family "XX" from your Hand/Removed Zone, without paying the cost, and draw a card.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [On Stage] or [On Stage: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [On Stage]", "give [On Stage]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
